name: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
note_A: trade receivables before allowance
note_B: gross before allowance; net already maps (R3)
adjudication_note: The node is a CARRYING-AMOUNT concept (ifrs_tag PropertyPlantAndEquipment / TradeAndOtherCurrentReceivables) and the net variant already maps to it. Kontablo's core has no contra-asset leaf, so a gross measure has no partner account; mapping both gross and net to one leaf would double-count the same asset. Documented core gap: no contra-asset representation. Ruled with B.

name: Accrued Income Taxes, Noncurrent
note_A: R3 tier: income tax payable concept, noncurrent portion
note_B: non-current tax liability; tax node is current only
adjudication_note: P1: the tag explicitly asserts the opposite balance-sheet tier from the only candidate node. Kontablo encodes the tier in the node id and derives working capital from it, so mapping across the split would corrupt current/non-current subtotals silently -- the class of error H4 exists to catch. Documented core gap: no node for this tier of this concept. Ruled with B.

name: Accrued Liabilities and Other Liabilities
note_A: accrued dominant in composite line
note_B: combined accrued + undifferentiated other (R2)
adjudication_note: P3: a combined caption whose contents provably extend beyond the node's boundary does not denote the node; the excess has no leaf. Ruled with B.

name: Adjustments for current tax of prior periods
note_A: R6 prior-period component of current tax expense
note_B: prior-period tax true-up disclosure; no node
adjudication_note: IAS 12.80(b) lists 'adjustments recognised in the period for current tax of prior periods' as a COMPONENT of tax expense, not a rate-reconciliation percentage. A component of the period's income tax expense denotes expense.tax. Ruled with A.

name: Agricultural Related Inventory, Growing Crops
note_A: growing crops classified as inventory
note_B: growing crops = biological assets, a pending_account (R4)
adjudication_note: Growing crops are biological assets (IAS 41), which level3_accounts.yaml deliberately parks in `pending_accounts` rather than the core. Mapping them to inventory would contradict the ontology's own explicit deferral. Ruled with B.

name: Asset Retirement Obligation, Accretion Expense
note_A: unwinding of discount is a finance cost (IAS 37.60)
note_B: accretion of an ARO provision Kontablo does not model
adjudication_note: IAS 37.60 requires the increase in a discounted provision from the passage of time to be recognised as a BORROWING COST, and the node is ifrs-full:FinanceCosts. Grounded in a citable standard rather than in US presentation practice (which often shows accretion in operating expense). Ruled with A.

name: Business Combination, Recognized Asset Acquired, Asset
note_A: total identifiable assets acquired
note_B: acquisition-date disclosure, not a ledger balance
adjudication_note: Purchase-price-allocation disclosure: an amount recognised AT the acquisition date, i.e. a transaction event, not a period-end ledger balance. A balance is an account, a movement is not. Ruled with B.

name: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operations
note_A: cash balance scoped to a disposal group
note_B: restricted cash + disposal group; breaks cash definition
adjudication_note: The tag bundles RESTRICTED cash into the total. asset.current.cash is defined as cash available for unrestricted use, and the core has no restricted-cash leaf, so the total is neither the cash node nor a rollup of existing leaves (P4). Notable because this is the most common cash element in US filings. Ruled with B.

name: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, before Allowance for Credit Loss
note_A: HTM debt securities held as long-term investments
note_B: HTM portfolio spans current+non-current; not equity-method investment
adjudication_note: The node's declared anchor is ifrs-full:InvestmentsAccountedForUsingEquityMethod; HTM debt securities are a different asset class and the tag asserts no non-current classification. Recorded defect: the node's label_en ('Long-term Investments') is much broader than its own ifrs_tag, and under the broad reading this WOULD map -- a third ontology inconsistency, and the direct cause of this disagreement. Ruled with B.

name: Incentive Fee Expense, Income-Based
note_A: fund adviser incentive fee; no core leaf
note_B: external management fee = administrative expense (R2)
adjudication_note: P5: the ontology's own aggregation rule is `ebit = gross_profit - expense.admin`, making expense.admin the SOLE operating-expense deduction -- so within this ontology it denotes operating expense other than COGS/D&A/interest/tax, not narrow G&A. Labeling the largest US opex line as having no Kontablo representation would contradict the ontology's own EBIT rule. Recorded defect: the node's ifrs_tag (AdministrativeExpenses) and its aggregation role disagree, and that ambiguity -- not labeler error -- produced this disagreement. An external adviser/management fee is an operating expense of the fund. Ruled with B here, and with A on SG&A -- the same principle cuts both ways, which is why it is stated as a rule rather than applied ad hoc.

name: Interest Income, Operating, Paid in Cash

note_B: cash-basis measure, not accrual income (R1)

name: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Tax

note_B: OCI subtotal
